newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia initial public offerings - April 9.
newsitem.headline: Australia initial public offerings - April 9.

text.p: The companies listed have made application for admission to the official list of the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) and have been allocated a provisional ASX code. The ASX advises that allocation of a code does not imply that the company's application will be approved. Listing dates are expected listing dates but are subject to change.
